mission: Re-run the S3 ownership evaluation on the post-E05 corrected gold plus any labels added since, grouped by independent player/session; compare against the Wave C baseline and the e05 after-eval; identify the current worst ownership slice and produce a forensic report on its top 3 failures.

labelsAddedSinceE05.evidence: git log c97925b..HEAD -- datasets/paddle-bench touches only wave-D2 CONTACT audit sidecars (afn-sasebo-rally1/2, wavea-faead-feed); no ownership annotation, sidecar, or correction file changed since the e05 merge

evaluator.datasetScope: dev split only (8 cases, 39 dual frames, 18 with committed pose), grouped by source session; held-out wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 untouched and excluded; fresh-candidate pool untouched

results.identityCheck: field-by-field comparison of dualFrames/framesWithPose/all method correct/scored/abstained counts between f14-ownership-eval.json and wave-e/e05-ownership-eval-after.json: equal

comparison.note: no ranking flips; on corrected gold the incumbent's correct-count lead over B1 is gone (13 vs 13 on pose subset); its only remaining edge is precision-when-answering (.765 vs .722)

worstSlice.slice: dvids-944403 group / wavea-944403-dink dark_on_dark dual frames (pose subset)
worstSlice.claim: all 4 incumbent wrong picks on the entire dev bench land in this slice (4/17 answered = 23.5% wrong-pick rate overall, 4/13 = 30.8% within the group); every other failure elsewhere is an abstention on the five no-committed-pose cases, a data-availability gap rather than a ranking error

topFailures.note: picked point is the ADJ-D7 human-adjudicated corrected coordinate
4th wrong pick, same signature, documented for completeness

results.rootCause: single shared signature: an other-owned paddle sits 0.02-0.07 from the target's leading wrist — strictly closer than the true target paddle (low at y~0.46-0.53 during the dink) — while the intruding paddle's owner has NO detected wrist near it in committed pose (all other wrists at x>=0.44), so the otherOwnershipFactor=0.85 veto misses by 2-8x and nearest-target-wrist ranking picks the intruder; the gold target paddle is never vetoed on these frames (ranking fails, not the veto), and B1/B2 fail the same frames, so no committed-data method survives the slice

waveGDecision.reason: 100% of live wrong picks share a failure mode that wrist-distance ranking with a wrist-presence-dependent veto structurally cannot fix (threshold would need ~0.12 vs 0.85 to catch the worst case, vetoing nearly everything); Wave G should explore wrist-free ownership evidence: person-box/limb association, temporal handover consistency (the intruder persists at ~(0.30,0.37) across 21171-22589ms), paddle-height-vs-wrist-height plausibility
waveGDecision.regressionContract: f14OwnershipForensics.test.ts pins the 4 current wrong picks; a Wave G fix must flip those pins consciously, citing f14-forensics-evidence.json

gates.formatCheck: pnpm format:check clean on f14 files
gates.tests: packages/swing-lab vitest: f14OwnershipForensics.test.ts 9/9 pass alongside ownershipBench.test.ts 15/15

honesty.productionMutation: none — evaluator, tracker gates, and all production code untouched; only eval artifacts + one regression-fixture test added
